'''Led Daragon''' was a [[Color/Legends|light]]-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="DaG" /> [[Coruscanti/Legends|member]] of<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] elite society during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CSWE" /> a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="Clone Wars">{{CSWECite|I|131|Clone Wars}}</ref> which lasted from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> He frequented the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]]<ref name="CSWE" /> located in Coruscant's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|acros_krik|Acros-Krik}}</ref>

In 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="BBY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Daragon attended the [[Opera/Legends|opera]] house<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> during a performance of the ballet [[Squid Lake/Legends|''Squid Lake'']],<ref name="ROTS IS">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref> standing beside a member of the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] [[Species/Legends|species]] at the bottom of the opera house's entrance stairs. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] ran past the duo on his way to meet with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in Palpatine's [[Palpatine's private viewing box|private viewing box]].<ref name="ROTS" /> At that performance, Daragon wore a gray [[Jacket/Legends|overcoat]] with a white [[shirt]], gray [[Clothing/Legends|pants]], brown [[Belt/Legends|belt]], and a black [[Hat/Legends|hat]] and [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="DaG" /> He shared his name with the [[Daragon family|Daragons]], a [[Tetan/Legends|Tetan]] family of [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] active around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Led Daragon first appeared, portrayed by an uncredited extra, in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> which premiered on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year By Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The opera house scenes featuring the character were filmed at [[Shepperton Studios]] as part of additional photography on [[August 23]], [[2004]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Daragon was first identified by name in the reference book ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', written by [[Trisha Biggar]]<ref name="DaG" /> and released on [[October 11]], 2005.<ref name="DressingDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archivedate=20260701041521}}</ref>
